name: s1
sql: SELECT ENGINE FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'app'

name: s2
sql: SELECT TABLE_ROWS FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'app'

name: s3
sql: SELECT IS_NULLABLE, COLUMN_DEFAULT, COLUMN_KEY FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'app' AND TABLE_NAME = 'p'

name: s4
sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'information_schema' AND TABLE_NAME = 'STATISTICS' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

name: s5
sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'information_schema' AND TABLE_NAME = 'STATISTICS' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION + 0

name: s8
sql: SELECT UPDATE_RULE, DELETE_RULE FROM information_schema.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = 'app'

name: s9
sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'app' ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION
